lines.text: The published H22 CI run [38867096208](https://github.com/TheHalfMoon/Hala/actions/runs/38867096208) failed in `test_reference_ast_and_h19_bytes_unchanged`: `git show 11a3a5359afa896787198e0492ccd036d0b6f4f8:evaluation/development_runtime.py` exited128 because the default shallow checkout omitted the immutable historical reference. The run reached237 tests and reported one error/one skip; this was a checkout-history failure, not a model-runtime failure. The workflow now sets the existing pinned checkout action's `fetch-depth: 0`, making repository history available to the unchanged reference assertions. Runtime, tests and prospective freeze bytes remain unchanged. Actual rerun green is pending publication and CI execution; no YAML-mirror test substitutes for that evidence.
